rachel-dx: FYI - onboarding broke for a few new users after we moved to a tight exports map + bumped peer deps. Edge samples (Vercel/CF) pick the wrong entry and types are missing. Minimal repro attached.

omar-sdk: Ouch. Which package version and sample?

rachel-dx: @redwood/sdk@2.1.0, sample/edge-quickstart. Steps: npm i @redwood/sdk@2.1.0 -> next dev -> call API. Errors: `TypeError: sdk_1.default is not a function` and `Could not find declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk'`.

yun-build: I packed the published tarball and confirmed dist/types wasn't present due to a race in the types build step. Also exports only had import/require (no edge/browser conditionals).

paul-bundler: Many bundlers will fall back to require for unknown conditions or older node. Cloudflare/Vercel packagers have their own resolver quirks. If they pick CJS but consumers expect ESM shapes, runtime blows up.

omar-sdk: Two quick fixes: (1) ensure types are in the tarball (add files and fail publish if missing), (2) add an `edge` conditional and a `default` fallback in exports so older resolvers get a usable path. Example: ```"exports":{ ".": { "edge": "dist/edge/index.mjs", "import": "dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "dist/cjs/index.js", "default": "dist/esm/index.mjs" }, "./auth": "dist/auth/index.mjs" }```

rachel-dx: Another issue: samples used deep imports like `@redwood/sdk/lib/format`. The strict exports map blocks these and we saw `Package subpath './lib/format' is not defined by "exports"`.

yun-build: We should either re-add permissive subpath exports for a patch or update all samples to stop deep imports. Short-term: add `"./lib/*": "dist/lib/*"` entries; long-term: refactor samples and lint to ban deep imports.

paul-bundler: Also add an edge CI job that installs the packed tarball and builds the sample using Node 14/16 matrix to catch resolver differences. Add smoke `esbuild`/webpack bundling to the publish pipeline.

omar-sdk: Agreed. I'll cut a 2.1.1 patch with: include types/files, add edge/default conditional, add permissive subpath exports for `./auth` and `./lib/*`, and a changelog entry describing the migration.

ci-bot: CI: tests/edge/onboarding failed on main (import error) - blocking release.

yun-build: I'll harden publish script to run `npm pack` and build the packed artifact in a minimal container. Also add a prepublish smoke test that installs the tarball into the sample.

rachel-dx: Please also update docs with resolver troubleshooting snippets for Next/Vercel/Cloudflare and a webpack/esbuild alias workaround example for users who hit this before the patch lands.

omar-sdk: Filing GH issue with repro + logs and assigning: https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/938. Will post patch PR shortly.

paul-bundler: Small runtime mitigation: detect sync vs async token providers at startup and normalize to async with a logged migration hint to avoid auth retry storms when the wrong build lands in the bundle.

yun-build: Released the smoke-test ticket in the release pipeline backlog.

omar-sdk: Cutting 2.1.1 now. Thanks for the fast catch. :shipit:
